free_parameters.name: shape_size
free_parameters.why: tensor length is irrelevant to loss_fn.dispatch(type(op)) and to whether the output is finite; fixed at 2 for both inputs

free_parameters.name: dtype
free_parameters.why: the registered losses and finite/overflow arithmetic are float32 in the repository; fixed for both inputs

free_parameters.name: seed
free_parameters.why: fixed torch seed so PracticalHybridSearch's differentiability probe and the run are reproducible

free_parameters.name: timeout_ms
free_parameters.why: gives grad_input_gen time to enter its first iteration; both cases leave the loop after that one iteration, so the count does not depend on timing

free_parameters.name: overflow_value
free_parameters.why: largest float32-representable finite value used as Mul input so the product overflows to +inf while debug_numeric still sees finite inputs
